notes.text: Pinnamaneni Krishnarao told the owner that Indian papers and politicians complain about high power prices Maharashtra state govt pays Enron, since naphtha prices more than doubled in 1999 and fuel cost is a pass-through; they requested help pricing naphtha caps.

Krishnarao priced monthly naphtha caps using 1999 prices as forwards: historical naphtha volatility 34% over last 2 years; ATM cap premium 10.4% of avg 2000 price (13% if FP=$224/MT), 10% OTM 6.8%, 20% OTM 4.4%; $200 cap 9%.
Krishnarao advised Anshuman Srivastav, Rajesh Sivaraman and Sandeep Kohli that protection from price rises above current levels costs 10-15%, indicative only; real forward prices are needed.
Krishnarao asked the India team to contact John L Chismar in Singapore, who trades naphtha, for 2000 naphtha forward prices and volatilities.
Krishnarao proposed installing the Exotic Options Library on a common drive in the India team's office (works directly if drive is G, J, M, O or P; otherwise programming needed).
